description: Revokes owner tokens. Inputs: token, and optional scope. Scope "current" (the default) revokes the token that was sent. Scope "all" revokes every token for that principal, including any overlap window. A later request with a revoked token returns 401 token_revoked, which is distinct from 403 suspended. Sites stay online. Without a recovery email, a revoked token cannot update them.

scope.description: current revokes only this token. all revokes every token for the principal. Default current.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: revoke_token
title: Revoke an owner token
